set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: W01.5
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend and frontend engineers
Scope: Expose reproducible full BIDS retrieval as a recoverable product operation.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: W01 (bd-01M4W40KKEG53SX6WJ17NQVQSV)
Suggested delivery tranche: T4; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Freeze exact retained releases/manifests and the caller's declared export scope; materialize isolated copies with path/byte verification.
2. Provide bounded progress, retrieval and retry/resume semantics under current authority, leases and storage limits; no partial bundle is labeled complete.
3. Define expiry/cancellation and revoked-access behavior for materializations, including cached exports and large interrupted delivery; preserve accepted source bytes.
4. Use a durable delivery identity and manifest/digest receipt; authenticate range/resume/cache retrieval at the delivery boundary, and ensure expired or canceled work cannot retain unaccounted storage indefinitely.

Verification: Export/re-import or exact tree/hash oracle, lost-response and revoked/resumed delivery tests with memory/capacity measurements.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/W01.5/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/NativeRepository.scala
- docs/http-api.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- F03.4: bd-01M4W5P5RX4RKKKDM2NSCV30RY
- O02.4: bd-01M4W5P8JRY7KB6KQJREBCXEAN
- W01.1: bd-01M4W5PACGC0YY1Q22W0AVAFCH

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: W01.5: Implement durable full-export planning and verified delivery
